svg.aria-label: Three separate breaks between an MCP tool and the model: the gateway tool policy filtered the MCP tools out entirely, the gateway result formatter dropped the tool's text content in favour of structuredContent, and the workspace instructions file told the model to convert SI units, contradicting the persona rule that said to quote the rendered string.
